name: Seed Profile Create + Warehouse Upgrade Suite
description: Four-state Alice/Bob seed: Job 2 HTTP, Postgres, device UI, and on-device AsyncStorage. SUCCESS only if all four match.

steps.description: Generate CSVs and load Alice/Bob through Job 2 HTTP
Job 2 health with live warehouse
Job 2 login as Alice seed
Job 2 login as Bob seed
Alice user exists in Postgres
steps.sql: SELECT email FROM users WHERE email = 'alice.seed@jobready.dev';

steps.description: Bob user exists in Postgres
steps.sql: SELECT email FROM users WHERE email = 'bob.seed@jobready.dev';

steps.description: Alice profile row is linked to the user
steps.sql: SELECT p.email FROM profiles p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.email = 'alice.seed@jobready.dev';

steps.description: Alice master resume row exists
steps.sql: SELECT r.id FROM resumes r JOIN profiles p ON p.id = r.profile_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.email = 'alice.seed@jobready.dev' AND r.id = 'resume_alice_seed';

steps.description: Alice first name from seed payload is on the resume row
steps.sql: SELECT first_name, surname FROM resumes WHERE id = 'resume_alice_seed';

If LoginScreen: Quick Start (Offline) to LOCAL
Hub after clear is Guest or already LOCAL
If GUEST: open Create Permanent Local from stage pill

If create-local form open: save local profile
Dismiss local-create success alert
Hub shows LOCAL stage before settings/upgrade
Open App Settings to point offline APK at local Job 2
Settings panel shows backend config
Scroll settings to reveal Node LAN preset
Select Node LAN Job 2 (:3000)
Active server is Node Job 2 on :3000
Scroll to Done Settings
Done with settings (returns modal to profile VIEW)
Close profile menu so LOCAL stage pill is tappable
Hub still LOCAL after pointing at Job 2
Open online upgrade from LOCAL stage pill
Upgrade form is open

steps.sql: SELECT u.email, r.id, r.first_name FROM users u JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id JOIN resumes r ON r.profile_id = p.id WHERE u.email = 'alice.seed@jobready.dev' ORDER BY r.id;
